reference_style: DSH compact capability workspace with MiniMax Code level density
purpose: 让共享宿主和所有 OPL 自有 MiniApp 在不同领域布局下仍保持可识别的同一家族外观。
required_markers: top chrome or brand block visibly contains the OPL Apps label
domain name remains visible beside the family label
status and readiness use the shared badge and live status treatment

shared_components.chrome: compact top bar with family label, domain title, status and host actions
shared_components.controls: minimum 40px hit area, 10-14px radius, shared accent hover and active states
shared_components.focus: visible accent ring for keyboard focus
shared_components.surfaces: neutral canvas and raised white/dark surfaces with one-pixel borders
shared_components.feedback: loading/error/empty states preserve the page frame and use aria-live or alert

domain_freedom: 领域可以使用列表、时间线、邮件编辑器或媒体审看布局，但不得替换 family tokens, markers or accessibility baseline.
